FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT CUM NATIONAL CENTRE FOR HUMAN GENOME
STUDIES AND RESEARCH
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Advertisement for the Post of Guest Faculty one (01) in the Department cum National
Centre for Human Genome Studies & Research, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Applications are invited for one (01) position of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) to teach odd
semester of the academic year 2023-2024.
Last date of submission of Application form: 10.08.2023 (05:00 p.m.)
Essential Qualification:
(i) Master’s degree in Human Genomics/Human Genetics/Biochemistry/Genetics/Life Sciences
or allied subject with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading
system is followed) from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited
foreign university. A relaxation of 5% shall be provided for the candidate belonging to
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Differently-abled/Other Backward Classes (OBC) (Non-
creamy Layer)/Ph.D. Degree holders, who have obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19
September, 1991.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualification, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
like SLET/SET.
(iii) Candidate who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with regulation of
the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from
time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET, provided, candidate
registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be exempted from the
requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to the fulfillment of the following conditions:-
a) Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode only.
b) Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners.
c) An open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate had been conducted.
d) Candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D. work out of which at
least one must be in a refereed journal.
e) Candidate has made at least two presentations in conference/seminars, based on his/her
Ph.D. work.
(a) to (e) as above are to be certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
Desirable Qualification:
 Ph.D. in Human Genomics/Human Genetics/Genetics/Biochemistry/Life Sciences or
allied subject.
Honorarium:
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with an
upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will
not draw any fellowship stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching in the
Department cum National Centre for Human Genome Studies and Research, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as Guest Faculty. The candidate who are already availing JRF scholarships in the University
are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be issued experience certificate for the Guest Faculty.
Instruction for applicants:
i) Applications should use the application from available for the post of Assistant Professor at
the website (http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecuitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformsperugcregulation2018.pdf)
ii) The candidate are required to submit one hard copy of duly filled form along with copies of
two set of attested certificate and other supporting documents to the office of the
Chairperson, Department cum National Centre for Human Genome Studies and Research,
Pharmaceutical Extension Block, Panjab University, Chandigarh latest by August 10, 2023,
05:00 p.m.
iii) All shortlisted candidates called for the interview shall be intimated by e-mail/ phone. No
separate interview letter shall be sent.
iv) All applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification at the time of interview.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
(Dr. Shashi Chaudhary)
Chairperson
Department cum National Centre
for Human Genome Studies & Research
Pharmacy Extension Block
Sector 14, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
